descriptions_of_your_tools.assess_record_trust: Assess whether a specific WZDx work-zone record can be trusted for immediate TMC operational action (DMS warnings, 511 detour alerts, or CCTV verification). Use this tool instead of get_work_zones or check_location when an operator asks if a reported closure is reliable, stale, unverified, or internally contradictory. Inputs: feed ('FL', 'AZ', or a feed name from list_feeds) and record_id (exact WZDx feature id). Evaluates time conflicts first (start_date after end_date), then event_status and post-end-date updates against unified WZDX_NOW, verification flags, and vehicular lane consistency (excluding shoulders from travel-lane contradictions and treating alternating-one-way as a lane restriction). Returns an operational tier (High, Medium, Low, Scheduled, or Completed) with field evidence. High trust means the record passes the defined checks; it does not prove field cones are currently deployed without CCTV confirmation. Read-only.
descriptions_of_your_tools.estimate_closure_capacity: Estimate a screening-level freeway mainline work-zone capacity sensitivity envelope (in pc/h) for a specific WZDx record using the Maryland SHA Appendix A equation (fixed alpha = 13.4%). Use this tool instead of get_work_zones when a TMC operator asks how much capacity remains or whether a lane closure severely restricts freeway throughput. Inputs: feed ('FL', 'AZ', or a feed name from list_feeds), record_id (exact WZDx feature id), optional baseline_pcphpl (caller-supplied non-work-zone baseline in pc/h/lane, finite positive number), and optional baseline_source (text describing the baseline source). Refuses mainline estimation when the event is an exit ramp or non-mainline facility, freeway mainline scope is unconfirmed, lanes are missing, no general lanes exist, or the lane configuration is outside Maryland Table 1. Reports speed-limit input quality separately and marks percentage drop unknown when baseline_pcphpl or its source is omitted. Output is a parameter-domain sensitivity envelope, not a field confidence interval. Read-only.

instructions: Work zones from public WZDx feeds (USDOT format): Florida (FL, FDOT via One.network), Arizona (AZ) and others from list_feeds. Times are local. Most work zones do not report lane impact and none has a verified position: say "unknown" and "reported", never "open" or "confirmed". No reported work zone does not mean none exists. If the question already supplies a record_id, call the relevant own tool directly with that exact string. Copy every character, including slashes, plus signs and trailing equals signs; never use a record ID as latitude or longitude. list_feeds lists feeds, not record verification. A rejected tool call is an error, not evidence about the record. If a record is not found, compare the argument with the question before concluding it is absent. When a TMC operator asks whether a specific work-zone record can be trusted or needs CCTV verification, call assess_record_trust(feed, record_id). Use get_work_zones or check_location to discover an ID only when needed. A trust tier never implies position verification: state a field is verified only if its own reported flag is True. False or unreported flags remain unverified, including when the tier is Medium. When an operator asks how much freeway mainline capacity remains under a lane closure, call estimate_closure_capacity(feed, record_id): it refuses non-mainline ramps or unconfirmed freeway scope and reports a parameter-scenario sensitivity envelope in pc/h rather than a field confidence interval. When it refuses an estimate, report mainline capacity as unknown; zero reported open entries in a ramp event does not mean zero freeway mainline capacity.
